notes: Cats: New Zealand in each bank carries the whole subject; Producers & Icons (Cloudy Bay, i-gv91mbr5), Geography & Maps (the vintage and latitude stems) and Viticulture & Winemaking (VSP, c-9oopzjj0) each hold a stem the Court asks but are far too broad to open for it. Chapters: the Régionale chapter nz and the Village chapter New Zealand. Regions: all seven the Court names have an article, marlborough (with the Wairau and the Awatere, the Court's two subregions), hawkes-bay (with the Gimblett Gravels, the Court's one soil), central-otago, and the Certified four, gisborne, martinborough (the Wairarapa GI and Martinborough within it), nelson and canterbury-waipara. Country: new-zealand for the GI ladder (New Zealand, North Island and South Island as names the Act protects), the 85 per cent rule, the temperance years and the screwcap. Grapes: the Court's nine, each with a profile; Gewürztraminer is the Régionale and Village profile and carries no New Zealand line, so the articles do the teaching. Techniques: maritime-fog for the maritime climates the Court lists (its usedBy names marlborough), training-pruning for the Certified history row on VSP (the reading teaches VSP; Scott Henry is named only in the gisborne article). No service table: the Court's screwcap row has no SERVICE_REF line to open, which the review logs as a gap.
